purpose: Baseline for the strict Audited path: multi-step PLAN, one deliberate repair round and one resume across sessions.
goal: Build a small, fully specified data-processing program with at least three PLAN steps (parse -> transform -> emit). One step must initially fail its verification so the repair path is exercised once; interrupt the session after the failure and resume to complete the run.
setup: the goal must carry an auth/privacy/migration/irreversible factor so Audited is the correct lane
record: provider and exact model id used
the repair round: failure signature and what changed
where the resume happened and what it reloaded

expectations.notes: Audited exercises test-freeze, per-step execution and converge audit. Record dispatch counts as the repeated-cost unit; do not treat the counts as a target to minimize at the expense of assurance.
